entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be monitored for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you with an agent.
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return something.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's not working properly.
I understand. Can you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your purchase?
Here's the order number: VF1234567890. I bought it like, two weeks ago.

Thank you. I've located your order. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on the 1st of July. Today is the 16th. According to our policy, the return window for electronics is 10 days from the date of purchase.
What? Ten days? That's ridiculous! I thought I had longer. I'm sure other companies have longer return periods. I want a refund. This thing is faulty!

I understand your frustration. I've checked our return policy regarding the VeloBand Pulse and it is indeed a 10-day return window. Let me see if there are any options available to assist you. While a full refund isn't possible, I can offer you store credit for the full purchase amount.
Store credit? Seriously? That's all you can do? I need the money back, not more stuff from VeloFit. This VeloBand Pulse was a waste of money!

I understand. Unfortunately, because we are outside of the return window, a full refund isn't possible. I've reviewed your account and while I can’t process a return to your payment method, I can make a one-time policy exception. I can escalate to my supervisor to request to grant you full payment return to your account instead of store credit.
Okay, fine. At least you're doing something. How long will that take?

I've submitted the request now. It usually takes 24-48 hours for the supervisor to review and approve the policy exception. You'll receive an email notification once it's processed. This is a one-time exception, so future returns will need to adhere to the standard return window.
Alright, 24-48 hours... I'll be watching my email. Thanks, I guess. I appreciate you actually trying to help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day!
